searchLog: Read life/PIPELINE.md, PROFILE.md, and OUTLOOK.md section 5 first. Note: the graduation-date conflict this routine's instructions warned about is stale — PROFILE.md shows it was resolved 2026-08-04 to December 2026, matching morning-briefing/profile.md exactly; no conflict remains to flag. Pre-exclusion from PIPELINE.md covered the full Oct 9-30 application spree (Stripe x2, Tesla, Simon-Kucher, IMC Trading, Enova, Point72 x2/Cubist, Graviton, Figma, McMaster-Carr, McKinsey, Robert Half, Retell AI, Tuck Bridge, IBM x6, Ford, Red Ventures, MIT Future Fest, CIL, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, MLH, Adobe x3, LSEG, Robinhood, Mathematica, Veeva, Claude Corps, Capital One, CarMax, Micron, Kalshi, CSE Grader, MATS, Anthropic Fellows, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM, Disney, Horizon Fellowship, Notion) plus the newly-surfaced Oct 30 Horizon 'next steps' email (ambiguous, needs Dom, not re-surfaced here). data/applications.json is still empty, no extra exclusions there. NETWORK: this is now a 9th consecutive day (2026-10-24 through 2026-11-01) of the same verification blocker, confirmed worse than ever today. Tested WebFetch directly against job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, www.databricks.com, www.metacareers.com, www.google.com, and even en.wikipedia.org (a control with no conceivable business reason to be blocked) - all failed getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND. The ONLY host that resolved all day was www.anthropic.com, fetched twice in full (both halves of a 103k-char page). This confirms yesterday's diagnosis: the session network allowlist is close to default-deny, not a per-site blocklist, and it is an environment-level problem outside this session's control, not something retrying or rephrasing a URL fixes. WebSearch (unaffected, separate service) surfaced the same three plausible candidates as yesterday - Databricks 'Associate Product Manager, New Grad (2027 Start)' (req 7586263002, Bellevue/Mountain View/SF, $133-150k, Fall-2026/Spring-2027 grad eligible per search snippet), Applied Intuition FDE New Grad 2027, and Palantir FDSE New Grad Commercial - but www.databricks.com, generalcatalyst.com (Applied Intuition's board), and jobs.lever.co (Palantir) are all unreachable, so none could be verified by loading the actual page as required. Per the honesty rule, a search snippet or job-board mirror (simplify.jobs, wayup.com, etc.) is not sufficient confirmation that applications are open and eligibility matches - so none of the three are included despite looking like strong fits on paper; worth a human checking the Databricks link manually. The one reachable domain, anthropic.com, was fetched completely (both halves): Applied AI (62 roles, all 'Applied AI Architect'/'Forward Deployed Engineer'/'Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise' variants, none new-grad-tagged), Technical Program Management (26 roles, all senior infrastructure/security/silicon TPM titles, zero 'New Grad'/'University'/'Early Career'/'Associate' in any title), and Product Management (26 roles under 'Product Management, Support, & Operations', same pattern) - no previously-unsurfaced entry-level opening exists, consistent with target-companies.json's note that Anthropic runs no new-grad SE/FDE/TPM pipeline and the research-only Fellows Program (already rejected, see PIPELINE.md Closed) is the sole structured early-career route. Zero verified opportunities this run - not for lack of fit, but because the session could not reach any job board, company career site, or even a neutral control site (Wikipedia) to verify an application is open and eligible. This needs the cloud session's network allowlist fixed at the environment level before the hunt can surface anything verified again; flagging prominently since this is now a 9-day pattern, not a one-off.
